This video is brought to you by Elements Destiny, a 2D fantasy RPG with pixelated retro visuals, an emotional narrative, and challenging turn-based combat. – https://store.steampowered.com/app/1635500/Elements_Destiny/

In today's episode, J & Ludo dive into God of War (2005) to see how its designs attempt to sell scale and how they may have gone slightly too far in some places due to time constraints.

Music used in order of appearance:
Intruder - Stray OST
The Abyss - Hyper Light Drifter OST
Checking in - Celeste OST
The Notebooks - Stray OST
Dead City - Stray OST
Secret Lab - Stray OST
